topPRs.title: docs: design doc for migrating to SuperDisputeGame
topPRs.author: stevennevins
topPRs.body:
**Description**                                                                                                                  
                                                                                                                                   
  Design for migrating existing single-chain dispute games (FaultDisputeGame/PermissionedDisputeGame) to SuperDisputeGame as a 
  prerequisite for interop.                                                                                                        
                                                                                                                                   
  Key updates:                                                                                                                      
  - Change 1: Update OptimismPortal2 with `_isSuperGameType()` helper to separate new code path in proveWithdrawalTransaction from the backward compatible path
  - Change 2: OPCM v2 `upgrade()` deploys SDG and switches game type atomically
  - Existing withdrawals stay valid via `wasRespectedGameTypeWhenCreated` flag                                                     
                                                                                                                                   
  **Tests**                                                                                                                        
                                                                                                                                   
  N/A - design doc only.                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                   
  **Additional context**                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                   
  This enables use to progress toward interoperability via:
  Step 1 of interop: individual chains migrate to Super Games. 
  Step 2 (future) allows interop sets to share a single SuperDisputeGame.                                                                                                         
                                                                                                                                   
  Related docs:                                                                                                                    
  - [OPCM v2 Design Doc](protocol/opcm-v2.md)                                                                                      
  - [FMA: SuperDisputeGame Migration](security/fma-super-dispute-game-migration.md)                                                
                                                                                                                                   
  **Metadata**                                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                   
  - Fixes ethereum-optimism/optimism#19007
